62-0

Kate Blum (9:17 A.M.)
Good morning, everyone. | just wanted to do a quick check to make certain
everything is in place for this Saturday's conference.

Ken Miyashiro (9:18 A.M.)
We're all set. And since the conference is sold out, we are going to broadcast it live
over the Internet so that people can watch it on their devices.

Yuri Kang (9:19 A.M.)
Is that completely arranged-camera operators, software, viewer access, and so
on?

Ken Miyashiro (9:20 A.M.)

Yes. We've hired everyone, and we have the software, so we should be ready.
People who want to watch the conference over the Internet still have to register
and pay on our Web site, and then they'll get online access to see Tom A kana's
keynote address and all the scheduled conference sessions.

Gabriel Lontoc (9:22 A.M.)
It's wonderful that Tom A kana has agreed to speak. It will be interesting to hear
how he created Honalo Coffee Roasters and built it into a profitable company.

Kate Blum (9:23 A.M.)

He is pleased to do it. He thinks it could help others who want to start restaurants
or food-related businesses. OK. | think that's it. Let's meet again on Wednesday
morning.

172.

173.

174.

Who most likely is the intended audience for
the conference?

(A) Photographers

(B) Software engineers

(C) Technology job candidates

(D) Food industry professionals

What is mentioned about the conference?
(A) In-person registration is sold out.

(B) Online access is free.

(C) The date was changed.

(D) The keynote speaker canceled.

What does Ms. Kang ask about?
(A) The broadcasting details
(B) The registration forms

(C) The Web site

(D) The hiring process

175. At 9:23 Am., what does Ms. Blum mean

when she writes, "He is pleased to do it"?

(A) Mr. A kana is glad to go out for coffee.

(B) Mr. A kana is happy to give a speech.

(C) Mr. A kana is satisfied with the
live-streaming arrangements.

(D) Mr. A kana is delighted with the work
arrangements.
